LanguageData.CC_GroupPlay_Does: {WHY} Those who come feel they belong, and their strain eases a little.
LanguageData.CC_GroupPlay_End: {LABEL} is over: {COUNT} of them came, and the group is closer for it.
LanguageData.CC_GroupPlay_Often: Every week or two, while the group is close, their anchor, {PAWN_nameDef}, calls them all together like this: those who come feel they belong, their strain eases a little, and the group grows closer.
LanguageData.CC_GroupPlay_OftenNoAnchor: Every week or two, while the group is close, one of them calls them all together like this: those who come feel they belong, their strain eases a little, and the group grows closer.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Formed_Does: Keeping their habits together gives them a sense of belonging and eases their strain a little.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Formed_Calls: Every week or two, while the group is close, {PAWN_nameDef}, its anchor, calls them all to {HABIT}.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Formed_CallsNoAnchor: Every week or two, while the group is close, one of them calls them all to {HABIT}.
LanguageData.CC_Group_HabitDoes: When two or more of them are together doing it, they keep it, once a day at most: they feel they belong, their strain eases a little, and the group grows closer.
LanguageData.CC_Group_HabitCalled: Every week or two, while the group is close, its anchor calls them all to it on the map.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_AnchorCalls: The one the group gathers round: warm, sure of themselves, good with people, with the most friends among them. They call the others together to the group's habit. The group is named for what its people share, never after them.
